design.joins: No joints; folds and the cut pattern hold the sheet together as one piece
design.purpose: A decorative six-pointed paper snowflake for a window, for one person
design.standard: Cut from one 21 × 21 cm square; opened size about 21 cm across
design.stands: One flat sheet; symmetry comes from the folded wedge and cuts made through all layers

ideas.pitch: Six-pointed snowflake from one folded square
ideas.title: Paper Snowflake

ideas.pitch: Folded paper plane that glides across a room
ideas.title: Paper Dart Plane

ideas.pitch: Linked paper chain cut from folded strips
ideas.title: Paper Chain

steps.c: Place the 21 cm square flat on the table
Fold top-right corner onto bottom-left corner
Fold top-left corner onto bottom-right corner
Fold right edge through top point at 30°
Fold left edge through top point at 30°
Cut straight across the wide end of wedge
Cut a triangular notch from left side
Cut a triangular notch from right side
Cut a small notch at the pointed tip
Open the sheet out flat to reveal snowflake
